name: Fruit Mold Ring-Around
description: A layered fruit mold dessert featuring red and lemon Jello with canned fruit and ginger ale.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat cranberry juice to a boil and stir in red Jello powder until dissolved.
Pour the red Jello mixture into an oiled ice cube tray and chill until firm.
Heat the fruit juice syrup to a boil and stir in lemon Jello powder until dissolved.
Add lemon juice and ginger ale to the lemon Jello mixture and chill until as thick as honey.
Cut the red Jello into ½ inch cubes and fold into the thickened lemon Jello along with the canned fruit.
Pour the mixture into a 1½ quart ring mold rinsed in cold water and chill overnight.
To serve, unmold and fill the center with raw fruit.

_similar.name: Cranberry Mold
_similar.description: A simple cranberry mold dessert made with raspberry Jello, sugar, and whole orange.

recipeInstructions.text: Put the cranberries and whole orange through a food chopper.
Mix the chopped cranberries and orange with sugar and raspberry Jello powder.
Put the mixture in a mold and set.

_similar.name: Lemon Salad
_similar.description: A light and fluffy lemon Jello dessert mixed with whipped Dream Whip.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve the lemon Jello in hot water with sugar.
Add frozen lemonade and ¼ cup water to the Jello mixture and let set.
Whip the Dream Whip Mix and combine with the set Jello.
